'''Version 1.9.16''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 30th 2024.  It was 22.47 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*Lag caused by the Primitive Vermin and the Gnat
*"Phase X Lure Block Cooldown Value" description typo
*Phase 8 Carcass Value" not working
*"Phase 8 Lure Block Cooldown Value" not working
====<u>Configuration</u>====
*"Mobs with new griefing task" added: "srparasites:pri_vermin;1;60;1",
*New options: "Gnat Cap" - "Gnats will not be spawned by Vermin or spawned naturally if the local number is greater than this. Natural Gnat spawns will respect the base + player caps." - SRPConfig.cfg
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*Gnat now has a lifespan of 1200 ticks (60 seconds)
*Primitive Vermin will now drop bombs (only if Gnat cap has been reached)
